standing_rule: Q64=1 (arbiter): data reaching UI / screenshot / evidence artifacts must pass source classification -> allowed fields -> render. mask is a helper, never the first gate.
interpretation_limit: a hit names a shape to justify, not a defect verdict; the lane answers either by removing it or by showing why that specific text is inside the allowed set. NO_EXPOSURE_SHAPE_FOUND only means this coarse net caught nothing.
